digest.component_or_area: tickets-branch push logging and severity classification
propositions: Expected, auto-handled best-effort tickets-branch push failures (contention races, transient retries, routine unpushed backlog) are logged at WARNING, priming agent sessions to waste tokens investigating non-issues and halting work

Mid-retry transient transport fault messages and unpushed-suffix backlog reporting contain vague wording (`..HEAD` bare reference, no self-healing contract statement) that cause agents to misinterpret routine contention as store corruption

Operators require expected contention losses and routine backlog to be suppressed from agent-visible output entirely (DEBUG at most) under normal load, distinguishing them from genuine operator-actionable outage signals (policy declines, strict failures, proven-growing backlog)

Four emission sites (push.py terminal, push_classify mid-retry, push_recovery merge/fetch legs) must be demoted from WARNING/INFO to DEBUG, with messaging clarified to name the tickets branch and state the self-healing contract
